answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 860 identities costs 860 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The beacon test is the live device, the pearl test is the locked stake, and the forge test is the graded history no template can fake.
